About 12% of Chinese children aged 13-15 reported being in a physical fight at school one or more times in the past 12 months, per the 2015 Global School-based Student Health Survey. I'm going from memory and haven't checked the source. The team note's figure of nearly two in three doesn't match what I recall and seems implausibly high, so I wouldn't rely on it without a source.
